description: This file defines the VTWorkflowApplication class, which manages URL generation and handling for workflow-related actions in the vtiger CRM module. It includes methods for constructing URLs for listing, editing, deleting workflows and tasks, as well as for error handling.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: A class that manages URLs and request handling for workflow operations within the vtiger CRM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the application with an action, setting request context and default properties.

methods.name: listViewUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for the workflow list view.

methods.name: editWorkflowUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for editing a specific workflow.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for deleting a specific workflow.

methods.name: editTaskUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for editing a specific task.

methods.name: deleteTaskUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for deleting a specific task.

methods.name: errorPageUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for displaying an error message.
